name: Lill-Stina på reportage i Storskogen
overview: Lill-Stina på reportage i Storskogen was Sveriges Radio and Sveriges Television's Advent calendar in 1964. In a children's news studio in the forest, reporter Lill-Stina and presenter Julle report on what is happening in Storskogen in the days leading up to Christmas. Through their reports, viewers follow various events among the forest's inhabitants and their Christmas preparations, where both everyday and imaginative happenings take place.
